answer: Sponsors are capped at 8 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army of aliases. Each vouch locks 63 POA until the newcomer survives 15 clean epochs, and a farm of 580 fakes must find 580 separate sponsors willing to risk real money on strangers. The ivory is the check that cannot be faked, the mesa is the price the attacker pays, and the atlas is the record that outlives the epoch.
